title: LieRE: Lie Rotational Positional Encodings
authors: Sophie Ostmeier; Brian Axelrod; Maya Varma; Michael Moseley; Akshay Chaudhari; Curtis Langlotz
summary: One local false global exponential-map statement; core forward rotation construction and qualified 1D reduction survive.

problems.title: Exponential is not a global bijective coordinate system

claim.text: The matrix exponential is a smooth bijection and diffeomorphism from the Lie algebra to every Lie group.

check.input: SO(2), J=[[0,-1],[1,0]], distinct Lie algebra inputs0 and2piJ
check.exact_calculation: J^2=-I gives exp(thetaJ)=I cos(theta)+J sin(theta); both inputs map to I.

problems.result: Global injectivity fails, hence global diffeomorphism fails.
counterevidence: Exponential is locally invertible at the identity; the local formulation is valid.
Section4 and released code only need the globally smooth forward map.
No historical score or optimizer harm demonstrated.
problems.impact: Supported local mathematical defect; no central dependency on global inverse established.

correction.statement: Restrict diffeomorphism to suitable neighborhoods; retain smooth forward exponential globally.
correction.verification: Exact planar angle chart on(-pi,pi); symbolic forward orthogonality checked.

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: The background makes an unrestricted global exponential-map bijection/diffeomorphism assertion, not merely a local claim.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: In SO(2), distinct 0 and 2*pi*J both exponentiate to identity. The encoder and inspected source use only the smooth forward exponential. Page 8 explicitly permits learned one-dimensional phases and relative plus absolute information.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor: a false local background statement without a demonstrated dependency on a global inverse in the core encoding method.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: Restrict the inverse statement to a suitable neighborhood; preserve the valid forward encoder and qualified one-dimensional equivalence.

scope_clarifications.result: Valid for learned phases as explicitly qualified in Section7; no issue established in that scope.
Not exact translation-invariant in general; paper expressly permits absolute information and contrasts commuting/noncommuting cases. Quantitative approximate guarantee unresolved.

limitations: Empirical significance and performance not independently reproduced.
Static released code not proven historical experiment commit.
Separate supplements and later correction history unresolved.
